storage: Keep the jar tightly closed in a cool dry cupboard; use a dry spoon so moisture does not cake it. No fridge needed.
looksLike: Fine brown-black granules or powder with a strong coffee smell, sold in glass jars or pouches.
howToPick: Check for "100% pure coffee" versus a coffee-chicory blend, an intact foil seal and a recent best-before date; granules should be dry and free-flowing, not caked or damp.
shelfLife: Unopened jars last many months; use opened jars within a couple of months and keep the lid tight (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Freshly brewed espresso or strong filter decoction

usedIn.raw: 3 g per serving (about 1.5 tsp, dissolved in 15 ml warm water)
